name: Paramount+

fastest.text: Sign in at paramountplus.com in a browser, open Account and select Cancel Subscription.

steps: Go to paramountplus.com in a web browser and sign in.
Select your profile name in the top corner, then Account.
Scroll down and select Cancel Subscription.
note: Subscribed through Google Play, Amazon, Roku or Prime Video Channels? Cancel there; the Paramount+ website can't cancel those.

faq.q: Got Paramount+ as a Prime Video Channel?
faq.a: Cancel it in your Amazon account under Memberships & Subscriptions. It keeps running even if you end Amazon Prime.

faq.q: Why isn't there a cancel option on my Account page?
faq.a: Usually because Apple, Google Play, Amazon or Roku bills you. You cancel in that platform's subscription settings.
Paramount+ Essential, with ads, is $8.99/mo in the US.
